rows.name: LIBERATING
rows.description: Aids wielder in detecting when a creature is under an enchantment. Striking a mentally controlled deals nonlethal damage, grants new save with a bonus.

rows.name: PEACEFUL
rows.description: A creature that has taken nonlethal damage from a peaceful weapon becomes shaken for 1 round each time it deals lethal damage to another living creature.

rows.name: SILENCING
rows.description: A silencing weapon makes no noise when drawn or when used to attack. Targets struck can be muffled, somewhat. Critical hits silence target.

rows.name: SLITHERING
rows.description: Weapon ignores half of AC bonus from cover, half of penalty from squeezing, and is harder to disarm or sunder.

rows.name: TRUTHFUL
rows.description: Weapon ignores miss chance provided by illusions, such as blur, and acts as a dispelling weapon against figments and shadow conjuration effects.

rows.name: UMBRAL
rows.description: Weapon is considered to have concealment for the purposes of attacks or effects directed at the weapon, grants wielder darkvision, 30 ft, while held, radiates 20-ft radius of darkness on command.

rows.name: UNSEEN
rows.description: Weapon, and scabbard, become invisible on command, may deny unaware target Dex bonus to AC on first strike, has total concealment against attacks or effects directed at the weapon.
